name: live
//: The paid live tier: the release llmlint -> real oneharness -> a real, authenticated harness. Its live target runs only in the Live workflow (live.yml); the gate tiers reach only its offline checks: format, lint, lint-sh and test (live_inputs.rs, which spends no model call).

test.//: Offline: live_inputs sources the real live-lib.sh and shows every setting it writes into a scratch config, every binary override and the harness id refused by name before any paid call, and its strict mode its own. The paid journeys are the live target.

live.//: Real (paid) model calls; a missing harness CLI, auth or oneharness is a hard failure. `just live-claude` runs it.
